about.ogTitle: About AYA Informatica RW – Builders of Africa's Digital Future
about.ogDescription: Meet the team behind AYA Informatica RW. Rwanda-based builders, engineers, and thinkers committed to Africa's digital transformation.
about.twitterDescription: Rwanda-based builders, engineers, and thinkers committed to Africa's digital transformation.
about.headline: Built From Rwanda.
about.sub: We are a focused team of builders, engineers, and thinkers committed to creating impactful digital products that change how Africa lives, trades, and connects.
about.overviewP1: AYA Informatica RW is a Rwanda-based technology company focused on building scalable digital platforms that connect people, businesses, and opportunities across Africa.
about.overviewP2: We take a product-first approach to solving real-world challenges, designing systems that are simple, reliable, and built for everyday use. Our work sits at the intersection of commerce, technology, and human experience.
about.overviewP3: At AYA Informatica RW, we are not just building applications — we are building the digital infrastructure for how people live, trade, and interact in the modern African economy.
about.quote: We are building for the future — but grounded in the needs of today.
